summary: Uni-Fuels Holdings Limited disclosed via Form 6-K that Nasdaq notified it of non-compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)) after its shares closed below $1 for 30 consecutive business days through July 24, 2026. The Company has until January 25, 2027 to cure by maintaining a $1.00 closing bid for 10 consecutive days or effecting a reverse stock split. If unresolved, delisting may follow, though an additional 180-day cure period could be available. The Company is evaluating options, including a reverse stock split, but no assurance of regaining compliance exists.
